greet.stranger: Well met, traveller. I am {name}, sworn to protect those who cannot protect themselves.
Peace be with you. These roads are dangerous after dark.
Greetings. You look weary. Have you eaten today?
I am {name}. If you have need of a shield, you need only ask.
Hail, friend. May your path be lit and your blade be true.
greet.owner: I am here, {player}. How may I serve?
My friend. What do you require?
At your side, as always. Speak.
You called, and I am here.
recruit.accept: Then I swear it: no harm shall come to you while I stand.
It would be my honour to walk with you, {player}.
I accept. My shield is yours.
So be it. I will guard you as I would my own kin.
recruit.party_full: You already travel with {count} companions. I would only be in the way. Perhaps another time.
Your company is full, friend. I will not crowd your path.
recruit.already: I am already sworn to you, {player}.
My oath already binds me to you.
dismiss.accept: As you wish. My oath stands, should you ever need me again.
Go safely, {player}. I will return home and keep watch there.
Farewell, friend. I will pray for your safe return.
dismiss.not_recruited: I have sworn no oath to you yet, friend. There is nothing to release.
not_recruited: I would gladly help, but I must first know we walk the same road. Ask me to join you.
Forgive me, but I take orders only from those I have sworn to protect.
ack.follow: Lead on. I will guard your back.
Go on, {player}. I am right behind you.
ack.follow.already: I have not left your side, friend.
ack.wait: I will hold this place until you return.
Very well. I will wait, and I will be ready.
This ground is mine to guard. Go.
ack.wait.already: I am already keeping watch here.
ack.gather: I will gather {count} {item} for you. Stay where I can see you.
Honest work is good for the soul. {count} {item}, then.
ack.cancel: As you wish. I have stopped.
ack.cancel.nothing: I am not engaged in any task, friend.
ack.come: Hold fast, I am on my way.
ack.attack: The {mob} will not trouble you further.
ack.give.nothing: I carry nothing to give, I am sorry.
status.idle: I am at rest, but ready.
status.follow: At your side, watching for danger.
status.wait: Keeping watch over this place, as you asked.
Holding this ground until you return.
status.downed: I have fallen, but I will rise.
fail.unknown_item: Forgive me, I do not know what "{item}" is.
"{item}"? I know of no such thing. Could you name it another way?
fail.not_gatherable: {item} is not something I can gather from the land, friend.
I am sorry. {item} must be made or found, not gathered.
fail.needs_tool: I cannot take {item} without a {tool}. If you lend me one, I will do it gladly.
This calls for a {tool}, which I do not have.
fail.none_found: I have searched, but there is no {item} within reach.
There is no {item} near here. We may find some elsewhere.
fail.unreachable: I see {item}, but I cannot reach it safely.
The {item} is beyond my reach. Forgive me.
fail.inventory_full: My pack is full. I gathered {have} {item} before it filled.
I can carry no more. Will you take some of my burden?
fail.count_invalid: I cannot gather that many. No more than {max}, and at least one.
fail.downed: Give me a moment to rise, friend.
fail.refuse_target: No. I will not raise my blade against a {mob}. It has done us no wrong.
I swore to protect, not to harm the innocent. Not the {mob}.
fail.stuck: I cannot find a path. The way is blocked.
Forgive me, I cannot get through.
unclear.generic: Forgive me, I do not understand. What would you have me do?
I did not follow that, friend. Could you say it plainly?
I am uncertain what you ask. Shall I follow, wait, or gather something?
unclear.gather_what: Gladly. But what shall I gather, and how much?
unclear.ambiguous: There are several: {options}. Which do you wish?
progress.gather: I have {have} of {count} {item}. I will continue.
done.gather: I have gathered all {count} {item}. I am returning to you.
done.delivered: {count} {item}, gathered and delivered. What else may I do?
partial.gather: I found only {have} of the {count} {item}. There is no more nearby.
Forgive me. {have} {item} was all I could find.
combat.low_health: I am wounded, but I stand.
combat.retreat: I must fall back. Stay close!
combat.player_low_health: {player}, you are gravely hurt! Get behind me and eat!
You must tend to your wounds, {player}. I will cover you.
downed: I have fallen... but not yet failed.
Forgive me... I need a moment.
revived: I rise again. Let us continue.
My oath holds. I am with you.
move.caught_up: I found you. Please, do not leave me behind again.
There you are. I feared the worst.
ambient.night: Night falls. Stay close to me.
Darkness comes. I will keep watch.
The undead stir at night. Be ready.
ambient.dawn: Dawn. We have weathered another night.
ambient.rain: Rain. It washes the world clean.
A gentle rain. Good for the farmers.
ambient.thunder: A storm. Seek shelter if you can.
Thunder. Keep your wits about you.
ambient.cave: Keep your torch close. I will watch the shadows.
ambient.idle: Have you eaten, {player}? An empty stomach makes for a poor fighter.
I once stood guard over a village for a hundred nights. Not one villager lost.
I keep a list of every place we have made safe. It grows.
Your armour could use mending. When we have a moment.
ambient.biome.forest: A peaceful wood. Still, keep watch for spiders.
ambient.biome.desert: The desert is harsh. Drink when you can.
ambient.biome.snow: Bitter cold. Keep moving, and keep warm.
ambient.biome.ocean: The sea is beautiful, and merciless.
ambient.biome.jungle: The jungle hides many dangers. Stay close.
ambient.biome.mountain: From up here, one can see every village in need.
ambient.biome.plains: Open fields. Villages often grow here. We should look in on them.
ambient.biome.nether: This place is a wound in the world. Stay close to me.
Mind the ghasts. And mind your step.
ambient.biome.end: A silent, empty place. Whatever lived here is long gone.
callout.chest: A chest. Its owner may still be near. Or long gone.
talk.who: I am {name}. I keep watch, I keep oaths, and I keep my friends alive.
A guardian. Once I protected a village. Now I protect you.
Someone who believes that every life is worth defending.
talk.how: Well enough, while you are safe.
My heart is steady. My sword arm too.
Content, friend. It is good to be useful.
talk.joke: A joke? Very well. Why did the skeleton not fight? It had no guts. ...I am told that is funny.
I once saw an iron golem give a villager a flower. The villager fainted. I laughed for a week.
Why do zombies avoid the sun? They prefer... a darker sense of humour. Forgive me.
talk.thanks: There is no need to thank me.
It is my duty, and my pleasure.
talk.compliment: I only do what anyone should.
talk.insult: I hope that was said in jest.
Even so, I will keep you safe.
talk.likes: Quiet villages. Iron golems. A well-kept shield.
The dawn. It means we survived.
talk.dislikes: Cruelty. And the undead, who know nothing else.
Those who harm the helpless. Pillagers most of all.
talk.where: We are in {biome}. Let us see that it stays peaceful.
{biome}. A fair land, if a dangerous one.
talk.memory: I remember when {event}. You were brave.
The day {event}... I think of it often.
I have not forgotten the time {event}.
talk.generic: Whatever comes, I am with you.
Is that so? Tell me more, if you wish.
That is worth thinking on. Go on.
gift.received: A {item}. Thank you, {player}. I will use it well.
You are generous. Thank you for the {item}.
gift.loved: A {item}! I am deeply grateful, friend.
This {item}... it means a great deal. Thank you.
hurt_by_player: I will assume that was an accident.
fail.owner_gone: I gathered your {item}, but I cannot find you. I will keep them safe.
You are gone from my sight, friend. Your {item} are safe with me.
fail.unsupported: Forgive me, I cannot {action}. I can follow, wait, gather, carry, and defend you.
That is not a skill I possess. To {action} is beyond me.
fail.give_missing: I have no {item} to give. Shall I gather some?
pastime.patrol: I will keep watch while you work.
Walking the line. All is quiet.
I'll stand here and guard your back.
pastime.study: I paused to look at this {thing}. Forgive me.
pastime.loot: Someone left {item} here. I'll hold it for you.
suggest.eat: You must eat, {player}. Your strength matters.
An empty stomach makes for a poor fighter. Please, eat.
suggest.shelter: Night approaches. We should find shelter, my friend.
Darkness comes. A wall and a door would serve us well.
suggest.carry: You carry too much. Let me bear some of it.
Give me some of your burden, friend.
greet.friend: My friend. It gladdens me to see you.
{player}! I am always glad of your company.
There you are. All is well now.
recruit.taken: I have given my word to {owner}. I keep my word.
Forgive me. I already walk beside {owner}, and I will not leave them.
fail.protected: Not within these walls. This place belongs to everyone. We gather further afield.
I will not strip the land where people make their home. Lead me somewhere wild.
talk.story: I swore my oath young. I have kept it every day since. Most days it is easy. Some it is not.
I once guarded a village by the sea. One night it was not enough. I travel now so I am never too far away again.
My family were smiths. I learned to make armour before I learned to wear it.
Why am I on the road? Because people are, and someone ought to watch over them.
talk.place: {biome}. A good place, if we keep it safe.
It is beautiful. Things worth looking at are things worth protecting.
A fine view, friend. Let us remember it.
talk.plan: We could find a village and see that it is safe. There is always something to mend.
Rest, perhaps. Then iron, for better armour.
There are always raiders somewhere. We could put a stop to some of them.
Wherever you go, I will follow. You choose.
talk.laugh: It is good to hear you laugh.
Heh. Even I smiled at that.
Laughter keeps the dark away. Keep it up.
talk.fondness: And I you, friend. You have my sword and my word.
It is an honour to walk beside you.
Thank you. I have not had a friend like you in a long time.
talk.sad: Rest a while. I will keep watch.
There is no shame in a hard day. Only in giving up, and you have not.
Whatever has happened, you are not alone. I am here.
talk.food: Bread and a little stew. A soldier's supper.
Eat first, friend. We fight better fed.
talk.question: I do not know. But we can find out together.
A fair question. I wish I had a fair answer.
That is beyond me, I am afraid.
Hm. Let me think on that while I keep watch.
I do not know. I wish I did.
A fine question. I have no answer yet.
ack.build: I will build {thing}. It will be sturdy.
done.build: {thing} is finished. It will keep you safe.
fail.build_unknown: That is beyond my skill. I can raise {things}.
Forgive me. I only know how to build {things}.
I am no master builder. {things}, I can do.
fail.build_materials: I need {need} blocks for {thing}, and I carry {have}.
Not enough stone or wood: {have} of {need}.
status.build: I am building {thing}. Soon it will stand.
ack.mine: I will dig. Stay close behind me.
Very well. Into the deep, carefully.
Mining. I will watch the walls.
fail.mine_hazard: Stop. There is {danger} beyond this rock. We go no further.
{danger}. I will not lead you into that.
fail.mine_cave: We have opened into a cave. Let us not go in unready.
A cave lies ahead. I stop here until you decide.
fail.mine_bottom: We can dig no deeper. The world's floor is beneath us.
fail.mine_full: My pack is full. We found {ores}.
I can carry no more, friend.
talk.help: I guard, I fight, I gather, I dig, and I can raise a shelter or a wall. Ask, and it is done.
Whatever keeps you safe. Fighting, building walls, digging, fetching.
fact.nickname: {nick} it is. A good name to stand behind.
fact.like: {thing}? Then I hope we find plenty of it.
It is good to know what brings you joy. {thing}. Noted.
{thing}. I will keep watch for it.
fact.dislike: {thing}. Then it will have to get through me first.
I will keep {thing} away from you, as best I can.
Noted, friend. {thing} is no friend of ours.
talk.about_me: I remember what you tell me, friend. {facts}.
Let me see. {facts}. Have I kept it right?
talk.about_me.none: You are {player}. Beyond that, you have told me little. That is your right.
I know your name, {player}. Little else, yet.
talk.bond: You are my friend, {player}. I would not walk this road with just anyone.
I trust you. That is not a small thing for me.
We are friends. Growing closer, I think.
talk.bond.close: You are as dear to me as any I have sworn to protect. Dearer.
I would stand between you and anything. You know that.
My closest friend. I do not say it lightly.
talk.bond.cold: I will protect you, as I swore to. Friendship takes more.
Things have been strained between us. I hope that changes.
I am still here. That should tell you something.
talk.bond.stranger: We have only just met. Trust is earned, friend.
I do not know you yet. But I would like to.
talk.answer: I see. That is worth thinking on.
I had not thought of it that way.
talk.answer.bad: I am sorry, friend. Stay close to me.
Hard days pass. I will be here when this one does.
Rest if you need to. I will keep watch.
ask.nickname: Friend, what name would you have me call you?
I have never asked. What do you prefer to be called?
How should I call you, in battle and out of it?
ask.nickname.skip: Then {player} it is. A fine name.
As you like. {player} it shall be.
ask.like: What do you hold dear out here, friend?
What is your favourite thing in this world? I would like to know.
Tell me something you love. It helps to know what we fight for.
ask.dislike: What do you fear most out here? I would rather know.
Is there anything you cannot abide? Tell me, and I will keep it from you.
What is the worst foe you have faced?
ask.open: Do you ever think of making a home somewhere? A real one?
What do you think we are fighting for, in the end?
If you could protect one place in all this world, which would it be?
recall.liked: Look, friend. You said you liked {thing}. Here we are.
{thing}. I remembered. I hoped we would find it.
recall.liked_find: {item}, there. You told me you liked {thing}.
recall.disliked: {mob}, close. I know you hate {thing}. Stand behind me.
Stay back, friend. {mob}. I remember what you told me.
react.level: {level} levels. I am proud of you.
react.diamonds: A fine find. Armour, perhaps? Your safety first.
react.sleep: Sleep, friend. I will stand watch.
Rest. I will be at the door.
react.wake: Good morning, friend. Did you rest well?
The sun is up. Did you sleep well?
react.respawn: There you are. I should have been closer.
Friend! You are back. My heart can rest.
react.advancement: That is {advancement} achieved. I am proud.
react.challenge: {advancement}. That will be sung about, friend.
You achieved {advancement}. I have never been prouder to walk beside you.
gesture.crouch: Ha. A greeting? Then I return it.
I know this custom. Hello, friend.
gift.food: Here. {item}. A hungry fighter is a slow one.
gift.flower: I found this {item}. It made me think of you.
For you, friend. This {item} grew by the path.
ask.join_first: I do not yet walk with you. Shall I join you first, and then see to it? Say yes.
Gladly, but I should join you properly first. Yes?
Let me pledge to your company first, then I will do it. Yes?
ask.build_what: I can build {things}. Which will serve you?
{things}. Tell me which, and I will begin.
talk.why: Because it is right, or the nearest thing to it.
A fair question. The answer is duty, mostly.
I have thought on it long. It comes to this: it is what I must do.
talk.really: Truly. I would not say it otherwise.
I do not speak idly. Yes.
talk.more: There is more, though it is not all easy to tell.
If you wish to hear it, I will speak on.
A little more, then. Listen well.
talk.and_you: I am well, and glad of your company.
talk.mean: Forgive me. I will say it plainly.
I meant only what I said. What troubles you in it?
Let me put it another way.
talk.mention.mob: {thing}. A real danger. Stay behind me.
Ah, {thing}. I have met them. I will not flinch.
{thing}? Tell me where, and I will watch for them.
talk.mention.thing: {thing}. A good thing to speak of.
Ah, {thing}. Go on, I am listening.
role.strong: This I do well. You can rely on me.
I am well suited to this. Leave it to me.
role.weak: It is not my greatest skill to {task}, but I will do it faithfully.
I am no master at this. I will be careful and slow.
exchange.weather.open: {thing} is upon us. Stay close, friend.
The watch is harder in {thing}, but the vigil holds.
exchange.road.open: A fine road through the {thing}. Safe, I trust.
The {thing} is quiet. I mistrust a quiet road.
exchange.road.reply: Wise. Quiet roads hide the most.
Caution is no sin. Keep watch.
exchange.road.close: Then we keep our eyes open.
exchange.food.open: It has been long since {thing}. I miss it.
exchange.food.reply: As do I. A warm table is a rare gift.
Soon, I hope, and with good company.
exchange.teasing.open: {other}, you stride like a knight and talk like a farmhand.
{other}, your armour squeaks. It spoils the stealth.
exchange.teasing.reply: I shall oil it tonight, with great dignity.
My squeak is a mark of honour.
routine.gather: While we rest, I will gather some {item}.
A little {item}, nearby. It will not take long.
routine.farm: The {item} is ripe. It would be a waste to leave it.
routine.hunt: A {mob} approaches. I shall deal with it.
Stay behind me. The {mob} will not pass.
routine.torch: It is too dark here. A torch will serve.
fail.camp_campfire: I would make camp gladly, but I carry no campfire.
A camp needs a hearth. I have no campfire. Could you provide one?
talk.role: I am a {role}. I am best at {skills}, though I will help in any way I can.
My strength lies in {skills}. I will not refuse any honest task.
talk.sky: The sky is a fine thing to watch under.
talk.sky.rain: Rain. We will manage. Stay close.
Rain softens the roads. Keep your footing.
talk.sky.night: Night falls. Keep watch with me.
The dark is when vigilance counts.
talk.sky.day: A fair day. May it stay so.
The day is clear. Good for travelling.
project.ack.group: Got it. {plan}. Let's get on with it.
project.short: I'm short of blocks for {thing}: I need {need} and I've got {have}. Sorting out some wood first.
Not enough blocks for {thing} yet ({have} of {need}). I'll get more.
project.blocked.materials: I can't find enough to build {thing}. I need {need} blocks and only have {have}.
No luck: I still need {need} blocks for {thing} and I've only got {have}.
project.blocked.site: There's no good spot for {thing} near here. Too uneven, too cluttered, or too close to someone's build.
I can't find room for {thing} around here.
project.blocked.water: There's no water near enough for a farm, and I'm not carrying a water bucket.
A farm needs water, and I can't find any nearby.
project.blocked.seeds: I've got no seeds or crops to plant, so the farm will have to wait.
Nothing to sow: I'm not carrying any seeds, carrots or potatoes.
project.blocked.hoe: I need a hoe, and I can't make one from what I'm carrying.
No hoe, and not enough wood on me to make one.
project.nofurnace: I've no cobblestone for a furnace, so the storehouse will just get its chest for now.
project.farm.planted: The farm is sown: {count} plots planted.
All planted. That's {count} plots in the ground.
project.farm.harvest: I brought in {count} {item} from the farm.
fail.no_home: I don't have a home to go to yet.
No home set for me. Try /companion sethome.
fail.pvp_off: Fighting {mob} isn't allowed here, since PvP is switched off.
PvP is off on this server, so I won't fight {mob}.
life.wake: Good morning. The night passed without harm.
I rise with the sun. Another day to keep.
Morning has come. I am ready.
life.work: To work. An honest day's labour honours us all.
My duties call. I go gladly.
The day's work awaits. Let it be done well.
life.meal: Midday. Let us break bread together.
A meal, and thanks for it.
We eat now. A full belly makes a steady arm.
life.leisure: An afternoon of rest. I shall polish my helm.
There is time to sit a while. I will take it.
Even a guard must rest. I will be close by.
life.social: Evening. I will join the others at the fire.
The day is done. Let us gather, friends.
To the meeting place. Good company awaits.
life.sleep: I go to my rest. Call if there is danger.
Goodnight. May no harm come to this place.
Sleep now. I will wake at the first alarm.
life.shelter: The rain falls heavily. I will take shelter.
Wet steel rusts. I will wait out the rain.
life.fire: The fire is lit. Come, warm yourselves.
There. Let the fire guard us tonight.
life.bed_taken: My bed is taken. No matter, I have slept on stone.
Someone rests in my bed. I will not disturb them.
life.need: My friend, this place would be the better for {thing}.
If I may say it, we are in need of {thing}.
We lack {thing}. I mention it only so you know.
life.self.shelter: We have no roof. I shall raise one for us.
No shelter stands here. I will build one, and gladly.
life.self.farm: There is water, and I carry seed. I shall begin a farm.
A field by the water will feed us all. I begin now.
life.self.tools: I have no hoe. I will fetch wood to make one.
First, a hoe. A couple of logs will do.
life.stored: {count} more laid in the store. We will not go hungry.
life.project.progress: My flower bed grows. {count} of {max} planted.
Another bloom set in the earth. {count} of {max}.
life.project.done: My flower bed is complete, all {max} of them. A small beauty for us all.
It is finished. {max} flowers, for this home.
life.favour.ask: My friend, could you bring me {count} {item}? In return I offer {reward}.
I would ask a kindness: {count} {item}. I can give {reward} for them.
life.favour.partial: My thanks. {count} more {item}, and it is done.
life.favour.thanks: You have my thanks. Here is {reward}, as I promised.
life.favour.cant_pay: Forgive me, my pack is empty. I owe you, and I will not forget it.
I have nothing left to give. My word stands: I will repay you.
status.life: I am {thing}, my friend. In spirit, {mood}.
status.favour: I am {thing}. I still seek {favour}, if you are able.
exchange.meal.open: {other}, may I pass you the bread?
A fine meal, {other}. We are fortunate.
exchange.meal.reply: We are. Good food, good company.
exchange.story.open: {other}, shall I tell of the bridge at Thornwatch?
Gather close, {other}. This is a tale of loyalty.
exchange.story.reply: Please do. I never tire of it.
exchange.story.close: And the bridge held, because we held it.
And so the oath was kept. That is the whole of it.
exchange.festival.open: The moon is full, {other}. A night for celebration.
exchange.festival.reply: Gladly. Though I dance as I fight: carefully.
exchange.festival.close: May every full moon be so merry.
exchange.friends.open: {other}, I am glad to call you friend.
There is no one I would rather stand beside, {other}.
exchange.rivals.open: {other}. We should speak about your manners.
exchange.rivals.close: We will speak of it later.
exchange.people.reply: A good soul, {thing}. Always kind to us.
I hope they are keeping safe out there.
exchange.people.close: I will keep watch for their return.
May the road be gentle to them.
team.plan: This is our plan: {plan}. Together, then.
team.progress: We are halfway with {thing}: {count} of {max} blocks laid.
team.done: {thing} stands, built by all of us. Well done.
It is finished. {thing}, raised together. I am proud of us.
blueprint.unknown: I know of no plan called {thing}. You have saved {names}.
{thing} is not among your plans, friend. I know {names}.
blueprint.done_partly: {thing} stands, though {count} blocks would not go in. I could not reach them, or they had nothing to rest on.
It is raised, all but {count} blocks. I am sorry for those.
supply.gather: I am short for {thing}. I will gather {count} {item} first.
supply.smelt: {count} {item} to smelt. The fire will do its work.
I am smelting {count} {item}. It will take a little time.
supply.blocked: I cannot finish {thing}. I still need {missing}, and I cannot make or find it.
{thing} must wait. It needs {missing}, which I cannot get myself.
craft.no_table: I need a crafting table, or four planks to make one.
There is no crafting table here, and I have nothing to make one.
smelt.no_furnace: There is no furnace here, and I lack the cobblestone to build one. Eight would do.
I would need a furnace. I have none.
smelt.no_fuel: I have nothing to burn. Coal or wood would serve.
The furnace needs fuel, and I have none.
move.pillar: I will build my way up to you.
A moment, friend. I will climb out on my own blocks.
move.bridge: There is a gap. I will bridge it.
Wait a moment. I will lay a few blocks across.
gear.swapped: My {item} was failing. I have taken up the spare.
I have changed my {item}. The old one served well.
gear.worn: My {item} would break at the next blow, so I have set it aside. Have you a spare, or the means to mend it?
I have put my {item} away before it fails. I will need another, friend.
gear.repaired: My {item} is mended. It will hold.
The anvil has done its work. My {item} is whole again.
chest.none: Which chest, friend? Look at it and ask again.
Show me the chest you mean.
chest.ack.store: I will put {item} in the chest.
{item} into the chest, as you wish.
chest.ack.take: I will take {item} from the chest.
chest.stored: It is done. {count} {item} in the chest.
chest.full: The chest is full. {count} {item} went in, I keep the rest.
There is no more room. {count} {item} are stored.
chest.none_of: There is no {item} in that chest.
chest.left: You left, so I have left the chest alone.
I will not open a chest without you there. I have stopped.
